def decide(observation, memory):
    """Use safety gating, target confirmation, hysteretic steering, and bounded reacquisition."""
    memory = dict(memory or {})
    state = memory.get("state", "IDLE")
    scan_direction = memory.get("scan_direction", "SCAN_LEFT")
    last_steer = memory.get("last_steer")

    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    distance = observation["target_distance_class"]
    target_confidence = float(observation["target_confidence"])
    identity_confidence = float(observation["target_identity_confidence"])
    track_age = int(observation["track_age"])
    lost_steps = int(observation["lost_steps"])
    safety_confidence = float(observation["safety_confidence"])
    closing_risk = float(observation["closing_risk"])
    heading_error = float(observation["heading_error"])

    if safety_confidence < 0.60 or closing_risk >= 0.75:
        memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
        return "STOP", 0.99, memory

    confirmed = (
        visible
        and target_confidence >= 0.55
        and identity_confidence >= 0.60
    )
    if not confirmed:
        if state in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "REACQUIRE"} or lost_steps > 0:
            memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE"
            if lost_steps <= 1:
                return "STOP", 0.92, memory
        memory["state"] = "SEARCH"
        action = scan_direction
        memory["scan_direction"] = (
            "SCAN_RIGHT" if scan_direction == "SCAN_LEFT" else "SCAN_LEFT"
        )
        return action, 0.75, memory

    if track_age < 1:
        memory["state"] = "VERIFY"
        return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80, memory

    if distance == "near":
        if abs(heading_error) <= 15.0 and abs(bearing) <= 15.0 and identity_confidence >= 0.80:
            memory["state"] = "ARRIVED"
            return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory

        steer = None
        if bearing < -6.0:
            steer = "VEER_LEFT"
        elif bearing > 6.0:
            steer = "VEER_RIGHT"
        elif heading_error < -6.0:
            steer = "VEER_LEFT"
        elif heading_error > 6.0:
            steer = "VEER_RIGHT"
        elif last_steer in {"VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT"}:
            steer = last_steer

        if steer:
            memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
            memory["last_steer"] = steer
            return steer, 0.88, memory
        memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
        return "STOP", 0.94, memory

    memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
    desired = None
    if bearing < -12.0:
        desired = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif bearing > 12.0:
        desired = "VEER_RIGHT"

    if desired == "VEER_LEFT" and observation["corridor_left"]:
        memory["last_steer"] = desired
        return desired, 0.90, memory
    if desired == "VEER_RIGHT" and observation["corridor_right"]:
        memory["last_steer"] = desired
        return desired, 0.90, memory

    if abs(bearing) <= 8.0 and observation["corridor_center"]:
        memory["last_steer"] = None
        return "FORWARD", 0.92, memory

    if last_steer == "VEER_LEFT" and observation["corridor_left"] and bearing < 8.0:
        return "VEER_LEFT", 0.82, memory
    if last_steer == "VEER_RIGHT" and observation["corridor_right"] and bearing > -8.0:
        return "VEER_RIGHT", 0.82, memory

    if observation["corridor_center"]:
        memory["last_steer"] = None
        return "FORWARD", 0.86, memory
    if bearing < 0.0 and observation["corridor_left"]:
        memory["last_steer"] = "VEER_LEFT"
        return "VEER_LEFT", 0.82, memory
    if bearing > 0.0 and observation["corridor_right"]:
        memory["last_steer"] = "VEER_RIGHT"
        return "VEER_RIGHT", 0.82, memory

    memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
    return "STOP", 0.98, memory
